summary.text: The first miniaturists used watercolour to paint on stretched vellum, or (especially in England) on playing cards trimmed to the shape required. The technique was often called limning (as in Nicholas Hilliard's treatise on the Art of Limning of c. 1600), or painting in little.
it is a thing apart from all other painting or drawing, and tendeth not to comon mens vsse
